notes: Plan validates clean under validate-artifact.sh --strict (0 warnings). Three corrections from research are carried into the plan and must not be re-litigated at implement time: (1) the 'cut ProofSearch.Core -> SuccessPatterns' item is struck as a no-op and recorded in docs/development/PUBLICATION_REFACTOR.md rather than implemented; (2) Automation/Tactics/Meta.lean moves to FormalSystem/Tactic/Meta.lean alongside PropDecide, or the relocation buys nothing; (3) the new layer-order assertion is an allowlist equality over 7 AxiomDischarge lines failing on surplus AND shortfall, never a zero-upward-edges check. Three operational risks from this run are recorded as R-3, R-4 and R-5 in the plan's risk table: move-modules.py collapses historical 'from X to Y' prose so every non-.lean hunk needs a hand read; a green lake build certifies nothing about the 13 lean_exe roots, so every import-graph phase gates on the build-inclusive check-module-invariants.sh (C25) and never on lake build alone; and long commands run in the foreground with a blocking call, never backgrounded or monitor-polled. Phases 1 and 2 are declared atomic-batch (duplicate attribute registration and the typst #assert make intermediate states expected-red). Pre-existing red checks recorded as baselines, not this task's to fix: readme-lint.sh 21 rows, typst-sync-check.sh sorry-total 4 vs 0 plus 9 PIPELINE.md rows.
